A daily log of what I'm working on, reading, and thinking about — Bayesian methods, causal inference, marketing science, and random side quests. New entries land here as I write them; you can also subscribe to the [RSS feed](diary.xml).

## How I add an entry

1. Create a new file in `diary/` named `YYYY-MM-DD.qmd` (or any slug).
2. Frontmatter: `title`, `date`, `description`, `categories` (optional), `section: diary`.
3. Write the body in Markdown — code, links, images, math all work.
4. `quarto render` — the entry appears here automatically, newest first.
